title: Ergotamine in an older person

plain_summary: Ergotamine is a migraine medicine that narrows blood vessels. In people aged 65 and over the risks are thought to outweigh the benefit.

medicine_groups.name: Ergotamine
medicine_groups.note: Includes ergotamine with caffeine. Dihydroergotamine is not named in the list and is not included. Cafergot tablets contain ergotamine and caffeine.

rule_for_models: Suspect a finding when ergotamine (alone or with caffeine) is supplied to a person aged 65 or over. If ergotamine is supplied and age is unknown, report only a possible finding and ask the pharmacist to confirm whether the person is aged 65 or over. One supply is enough.
cannot_be_seen: Why it was prescribed, heart and blood vessel disease, and how often it is really taken.
ask_the_gp: Whether ergotamine is still needed and whether a safer migraine treatment could replace it.
